app.name: OmniFamily Nexus
app.tagline: Your family calendar, tasks and chores — on this device, no account needed.

onboarding.title: Set up your family
onboarding.intro: Everything stays on this device. No email, no password, no account.
onboarding.pinHint: 4–8 digits. Leave empty to skip; you can add one later in Settings.
onboarding.pinDisclosure: A 4-digit PIN has ~10⁴ entropy and is a UX speed bump on a shared screen, not a security boundary.
onboarding.storageDisclosure: IndexedDB is not encrypted at rest in v1; the app relies on OS-level device encryption.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lastParent: The last parent cannot be removed.
settings.parentGate: Settings are for parents. Choose a parent to unlock.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Get a notification 15 minutes before each event. Reminders are created on this device; nothing is sent to a server.
reminders.denied: Notifications are blocked for this app. Allow them in the browser settings.
reminders.foregroundOnly: This browser has no background checks, so reminders arrive while the app is open.
reminders.iosNote: On iPhone and iPad, reminders need the app added to the Home Screen and arrive only while it is open.

pin.label: PIN
pin.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
pin.locked: Locked after too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

errors.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.

errors.invalidPoints: Points must be a whole number from 0 to 1000.

kiosk.title: Family overview
kiosk.setup: This device has no family yet.
kiosk.openHint: Full-screen overview for a tablet on the wall. The screen stays on; leaving it needs a parent PIN.

sync.lanNote: Devices sync directly with each other over the same Wi-Fi network. This version has no cloud relay, so both devices must be on the same network with the app open.
sync.hostStep1: On the other device, open the app, choose “Join an existing family” and scan this code.
sync.hostStep2: Then scan the code that appears on the other device.
sync.textCode: No camera? Copy this code to the other device:
sync.scanning: Point the camera at the code ({received} of {count})
sync.scanningOne: Point the camera at the code
sync.noCamera: This device cannot scan codes. Paste the code instead.

errors.unreadable: That code could not be read. Try again.
errors.wrong_code: That is not the right code for this step.
errors.household_mismatch: That device belongs to another family.
errors.no_household: Neither device has a family yet.
errors.protocol: The devices could not agree. Update both and try again.
errors.timeout: No connection. Are both devices on the same Wi-Fi?

join.title: Join an existing family
join.intro: Bring this device into a family that already uses OmniFamily on another device.
join.step1: On the device that already has the family, open Settings → Devices → “Connect another device”, then scan its code here.
join.step2: Now show this code to the other device.
join.back: Set up a new family instead

sync.connected: Connected. If the numbers match on both screens, you’re done.
